Wednesday, April 22, 2015 - 06:30 p.m.

24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717

CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular City Council Meetings held on April 8, 2015
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.
Item #6b
c.
Resolution 2015-16, Approving the Demands and Payroll.
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted approving the demands and payroll.
Item #6c
d.
Consideration of an Opposition Letter for AB45 (Solid Waste: Household Hazardous Waste)
ACTION: Direct the Mayor to sign the attached letter of opposition and transmit it to State Assembly Speaker Pro Tempore Kevin Mullin, each Member of the Assembly Committee on Local Government, Assembly Member David Hadley and State Senator Ben Allen.
Item #6d
e.
Resolution of Intent and set public hearing date for Landscape Maintenance District No. 1.
Resolution No. 2015-17 - A resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, declaring the intent of the City Council to levy and collect assessments within the Lomita Landscaping Maintenance District No. 1 for the fiscal year commencing July 1, 2015, and ending June 30, 2016, and setting a public hearing date of May 27, 2015.
Resolution No. 2015-18 - A resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita, California, ordering the Public Works Director/City Engineer to prepare and file the Engineer's Report for Lomita Landscape Maintenance District No. 1, in accordance with the Landscaping and Lighting Act of 1972, being Division 15, Part 2 of the Streets and Highways Code of the State of California, for the Fiscal Year commencing July 1, 2015, to and ending June 30, 2016.
1)
Consider the adoption of a Resolution of Intent to levy annual assessments for Landscape Maintenance District No. 1, and set a public hearing date of May 27, 2015; and
2)
Consider adoption of a Resolution directing the Public Works Director/City Engineer to prepare the Engineer's Report for Landscape Maintenance District No. 1.
Item 6e
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
6.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
7.
CONSIDERATION OF SCHEDULING FY 2015-16 BUDGET WORKSHOP AND PUBLIC HEARING ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council:
1)
Select a date for the FY 2015-16 Budget Workshop on Monday, June 1, 2015 at 6:00 p.m. or Tuesday, June 2, 2015 at 6:00 p.m. or Wednesday, June 3, 2015 at 6:00 p.m. and
2)
Schedule the FY 2015-2016 budget public hearing on Wednesday, June 24, 2015 at 6:30 p.m.
Item #7
8.
STUDY SESSION - CITYWIDE COMPREHENSIVE USER FEES AND CHARGES ACTION: It is recommended that the City Council:
1)
Review the proposed user fees and charges as recommended by the Finance Ad Hoc Committee and;
2)
Provide any changes to the recommended fee schedule and;
3)
Direct staff to schedule the public hearing on May 27, 2015.
Item #8
9.
DIRECTION REGARDING THE LEASE OF UNUSED WATER RIGHTS FOR FISCAL YEAR 2014-2015 ACTION: That City Council authorize staff to advertise the lease of up to 750 acre-feet of the City's unused groundwater rights for Fiscal Year 2014-2015 to interested parties.
Item #9
10.
CONSIDERATION OF THE 2015 LEGISLATIVE PLATFORM AND ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION Resolution No. 2015-19 - A resolution of the City Council of the City of Lomita approving the 2015 Legislative Platform.
ACTION: That said resolution be adopted.
Item #10
11.
ADJOURNMENT In memory of Joseph Vida Sr.
The regular meeting of the Lomita City Council for May 13, 2015, has been canceled, and a special meeting will be held on Tuesday, May 12, 2015, at 6:30 p.m.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
